skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — trim, add music, and export this video for free — and get edited MP4 video...

latestVersion.changelog:
Free Video Free 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and export MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM videos up to 500MB for free via cloud processing.
- Simple, prompt-based editing: trim, add music, change aspect ratio, overlay text, and more.
- No account required — obtain a temporary free token for 7 days and 100 credits per session.
- Automatic session setup, with support for multiple file formats and AI-powered editing actions.
- Real-time status updates, error handling, and download links for finished MP4 exports.
